name: Saptha Sthanam — the Seven Sacred Places of Thiruvaiyaru
theme: Seven Tevaram temples around Thiruvaiyaru whose deities travel together in glass palanquins to celebrate the wedding of Nandi
description: Around Thiruvaiyaru, where five rivers of the Kaveri delta run close together, seven Shiva temples are bound by one of the most loved festivals of the Tamil country. Tradition holds that for the wedding of Nandi, Shiva's bull, each of the seven villages supplied something for the feast: fruit from Thirupazhanam, rice from Thiruchotruthurai, Vedic priests from Thiruvedhikudi, ornaments from Thirukandiyur, flowers from Thirupoonthuruthi and ghee from Thillaisthanam. Each year in spring, the deities of Thiruvaiyaru set out in a glass palanquin and are joined village by village by the deities of the others, until all seven return together to Thiruvaiyaru amid night-long crowds and fireworks on the Kaveri sands. All seven are Paadal Petra Sthalams praised in the Tevaram.
